h1: The 6 Best Handheld Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six cordless handheld vacuums compared on filtration, attachments, pet-hair tools and charging.
summary: The DEWALT 20V handheld is our top pick, with HEPA filtration, six attachments and an LED light. The Shark WANDVAC is the compact, wall-mounted choice for quick cleanups, and the BLACK+DECKER 20V adds an extendible crevice tool. For pet owners the Shark Cyclone PET and the Bissell Pet Hair Eraser are the specialists, while the BLACK+DECKER AdvancedClean is the budget buy.
intro: Most handheld vacuums fail the same way: they are charged for a month, forgotten in a drawer and then found dead when the spill happens. That makes storage and charging more important than raw suction numbers, which no listing here backs with a measured figure anyway. A handheld that lives on a wall mount or a charging base is the one that actually gets used.

We reviewed six cordless handhelds on paper, comparing filtration, attachments, pet-hair tools, charging method and price tier. Listings rarely publish runtime or suction in comparable units, so the ranking leans on what each listing states clearly.

products.name: DEWALT 20V Handheld Vacuum Cordless, Car Vacuum with HEPA Filter, 6 Attachments and LED Light
products.verdict: HEPA filtration, six attachments and a light for dark corners.
products.description:
Named HEPA filtration, six attachments and a built-in LED light make the DEWALT the most complete handheld in this group. It runs on the 20V platform and is pitched for cars as well as the home.

It takes first place because no other listing offers filtration and attachments together, which matters for allergy-prone households and tight car interiors. The compromise is cost: it is the only pick in the $100 to $200 range.

Choose it for a garage or car-detailing routine. Pass on it if you only need to grab crumbs off a counter.
products.skipIf: You only clean small kitchen spills.

products.name: Shark WANDVAC Cordless Hand Vac, Black, WV201BK
products.verdict: A small cordless vac that charges on the wall.
products.description:
The WANDVAC is a compact cordless hand vac from Shark with wall-mount charging. That mount is the practical feature: the vacuum is on display, charged and within reach.

It slots behind the DEWALT because the listing names no HEPA filter or extra attachments. Where it wins is convenience, and it costs far less, in the $50 to $100 range.

Pick it for a kitchen or entryway where quick pickups happen daily. Skip it if you need car-detailing tools.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster 20V Hand Vacuum Cordless Rechargeable with Extendible Crevice Tool
products.verdict: A named 20V rating with a crevice tool that stretches.
products.description:
This Dustbuster states 20V power and includes an extendible crevice tool plus a flip-up brush. Those two tools cover tight corners and upholstery without extra purchases.

It ranks third because it has fewer attachments than the DEWALT and no wall mount like the Shark. Its strength is the stated voltage and the reach of the crevice tool, at $50 to $100.

Buy it for sofas, stairs and car seats. Skip it if filtration is a concern.

products.name: Shark Cyclone PET Handheld Vacuum, Navy Blue/Grey, CH701
products.verdict: Cyclone technology aimed at pet-hair cleanup.
products.description:
The Shark Cyclone PET is a pet-focused handheld with named cyclone technology. The cyclone design separates debris from the airflow, which is the idea behind keeping suction steady.

It ranks fourth because it is a specialist: the listing says little about accessories, and general cleaning gets the same tool. The price is $50 to $100.

Choose it if shedding is the main chore. Skip it for car detailing.

products.name: Bissell Pet Hair Eraser Cordless Hand Vacuum, Home, Auto & Pet, 2390A
products.verdict: Bissell's pet line for the home, the car and the dog bed.
products.description:
The Bissell Pet Hair Eraser carries Bissell's named pet technology and is pitched for home, auto and pet use.

It ranks fifth because the listing gives few concrete specs beyond the brand's pet focus, so it is harder to compare with the Shark. Pricing falls at $50 to $100.

Buy it if you trust Bissell for pet hair and want one vac for car and couch. Skip it if you want spec transparency.
products.idealFor: Pet owners who also clean the car.
products.skipIf: You want listed specs to compare.

products.name: Black+Decker Dustbuster AdvancedClean Handheld Vacuum Cordless, Compact Home and Car Vacuum with Crevice Tool
products.verdict: The cheapest way into a cordless hand vac with a charging base.
products.description:
The AdvancedClean includes a crevice tool, a rotating nozzle and a charging station. It is aimed at home and car cleanups.

It finishes last because the listing names no power rating or filter, but the accessories and the under $50 price make it the easy entry point.

Buy it for a first handheld or a dorm. Move up if you need pet or filtration features.
products.skipIf: You want filtration or pet tools.

whatMatters.detail: A HEPA filter captures very small particles instead of blowing them back out. It matters for allergies and fine dust. Look for 'HEPA' in the title.
A crevice tool reaches corners and a brush lifts dust from fabric. They decide how many jobs the vacuum can do. Check how many are included.
A handheld that is charged and visible gets used more. Wall mounts and bases help. Look for 'wall-mount' or 'charging station' in the listing.
Pet models add brushes or cyclone systems to handle fur. They help if your pet sheds heavily. Check for named pet technology.
A stated voltage like 20V tells you the battery platform. It helps compare power. Check the title.

faq.q: How long does a handheld vacuum battery last?
faq.a: Listings rarely publish runtime in comparable terms. Plan for short cleanups and charge it after each use.
It matters for allergies or fine dust. For crumbs and dirt, a standard filter is fine.

faq.q: Is the DEWALT worth it over the Shark?
faq.a: If you need filtration and attachments, yes. For quick kitchen use the Shark WANDVAC is easier.

faq.q: How do I clean the filter?
faq.a: Empty the bin, tap the filter clean and rinse only if the manual allows. Let it dry fully.

faq.q: How do I keep the battery healthy?
faq.a: Store the vacuum on its charger or at partial charge, and avoid leaving it in a hot car.

faq.q: Can a handheld replace my main vacuum?
faq.a: No. It handles small areas and spills, not whole floors.

finalTake: The DEWALT 20V is the best handheld vacuum overall, with HEPA filtration, six attachments and a light. The Shark WANDVAC is the compact pick for everyday spills, and the BLACK+DECKER 20V offers good reach. Choose the pet specialists only when shedding is your main concern.
